Results.ReviewText: Overall its built well and it was easy to assemble.  I wish it had a bigger warming rack as I can barely toast more than 1.5 buns up there.  The plastic wheels are not very good... already had one pop off a couple times within the first week due to the wheel causing the pin to pop off.  So far it starts nice and I've had several good outings cooking burgers, steaks, and tuna steaks.  It cost twice as much as my last grill that lasted more than ten years but I can't say this grill is twice as good.  I really miss my bigger warming/toasting rack :(

Results.ReviewText: The assembly process is a bit tedious, but it goes together well and is constructed soundly. The temperature consistency is great and it's ability to reproduce great results consistently is surprising for the cost. My only complaint to date is that every time I move the grill, one of the wheel covers pops off and the cotter pin keeping the wheel on the axle somehow pops off. I constantly find the snap on plastic wheel cover on the ground which informs me it's time to search for the pin. For the life of me I still haven't figured out how this is happening.
Results.Title: Overall good grill, very surprising for the money

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
